notes.title: v2.1 update, to fix bugs.
notes.content:
Two bug fixed:
1. To fix pineapple display.
2. To fix crash bug that sometimes happened when back to main menu.

notes.title: v2.0 update, we polished game art
notes.content:
We updated a lot in this version, so we set version to 2.0. The main updates are list as follows:
1. We polished the game art
2. Updated engine and now the performance is good.
3. Engine interface, we plan to release our engine.

notes.title: v1.76 update, an extra sub game: "ZionMatches"
notes.content: We updated game engine and added an extra small puzzle game (" Main Menu " → " About Us " → " H " → " Zion Matches " )

notes.title: Pine Apple Island v1.70 update
notes.content:
1. Update game engine: speed and animation improvements.
2. To fix a crash bug when back to intro.

notes.title: Pineapple Island v1.69 game engine update.
notes.content: The game engine has been updated to achieve better performance on some slower PCs.

notes.title: v1.63: New TNT animation.
notes.content:
TNT explosion range increased by 1.5 times.
There are 8 more levels of TNT that need to be upgraded.

notes.title: Pineapple Island now has achievements.
notes.content:
In v1.6, we add steam achievement
There are now 14 Achievements.

notes.title: Pineapple Island 87% off, May 24~31
notes.content: There is a beautiful island that produces all kinds of sweet fruits. This year, farmers planted super sweet pineapples. People fall in love with them as soon as they eat it. Farmers began to grow them in large numbers, but some pineapples changed.

notes.title: v1.55 released, Pineapple farm
notes.content:
1. To replace the black background by pineapple farm.
2. Increasing moving speed when full screen.
3. click anywhere to reveal mouse cursor.

notes.title: v1.53 New pineapple clone ability
notes.content: To add one new ability: clone all exist pineapples
